content.text: The licence grant fully meets our preferred position.

input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13.1 extends the subscription access right to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf (with Authorized Users permitted), so no affiliate/contractor gap exists. Section 13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables, reinforced by the Section 14.3 cross-reference and preserved post-termination by Section 10.1. Section 13.3 confirms transferability to an Affiliate or successor (consistent with the free assignment right in Section 24.1 and the change-of-control protection in Section 24.4) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity — there is no at-will revocation. The Section 13.4 restrictions are conventional, knowledge-qualified, and carve out authorized security testing and use of Customer Data and output, so they do not undercut the grant. No redline required.
